lessons.claim: Sweep concurrency must not be set from the load average but **measured by throughput**. Measured: a trap-drag (N=306) process launches 11 threads (HOOMD's internal TBB) -- hoomd 7.1's device.CPU signature has **no num_cpu_threads so it cannot be turned off**, and setting all of OMP/OPENBLAS/VECLIB/MKL/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 still left 11 threads (meaning it is not numpy BLAS). So launching only 3 processes sends the load up to 77, but **that is not a saturation signal** -- under the same background load, 1 smoke run took 84.7s against 124s for 3 concurrent, a throughput of 2.05x (68% efficiency). By contrast chain-bend (n=25) launches only 2 threads -- the thread count depends on the system size, so it has to be measured per case.
